rights_policy.rule: Swiss Post operator products, swisstopo PLZO and building-address directories, GWR identity, swissBUILDINGS3D and swissBOUNDARIES3D remain independently versioned evidence artifacts.
rights_policy.attribution: Every public artifact records provider, dataset, edition or retrieval time, access class, schema, CRS, digest, transformation and required source reference; swisstopo publications use the mandatory swisstopo source attribution.

sources.production_scope: Pinned public search receipts and explicitly contracted downloads; customer, recipient, forwarding, shipment and unlicensed GeoPost data remain outside public artifacts.
sources.terms_note: The postcode search is public and the sorting street directory is account-accessed; NPA6, GeoPost, coordinates, sorting and delivery products require per-product terms review.

sources.production_scope: Pinned monthly PLZO_CH release filtered to Switzerland, with data model, NPA4, NPA6, locality, postcode type, municipality links, LV95 geometry, attribution and digest.
sources.terms_note: swisstopo OGD permits use, processing, distribution and commercial use with mandatory source attribution. PLZO covers domicile-address types and does not include every Swiss Post routing code.

sources.provider: Federal Office of Topography swisstopo with Federal Statistical Office and cantons
sources.production_scope: Pinned daily official address release filtered to Switzerland, with EGAID, EGID, EDID, status, street, house number, NPA4/locality, municipality, LV95 coordinate source, attribution and digest.
sources.terms_note: The directory is published for free public and commercial use under swisstopo terms. Entrance coordinates can be more precise in storage than their measured accuracy; preserve provenance and do not claim false precision.

sources.production_scope: Pinned public GWR/geo.admin extract or query receipts limited to public building and entrance identity/status attributes, access class, release time, schema and digest.
sources.terms_note: EGID identifies a building and EGID plus EDID uniquely identifies an entrance nationwide. GWR also contains dwelling data; public AGID artifacts exclude EWID, occupant and non-public attributes.

sources.production_scope: Pinned canton/tile edition with model variant, flight year, publication date, LV95/LN02, EGID-coverage receipt, attribution, digest and geometry validation.
sources.terms_note: The product is beta and EGID integration is phased by canton/tile. Only features carrying the identical EGID can become definitive building geometry; all others remain candidate geometry.

sources.provider: Federal Office of Topography swisstopo with Federal Statistical Office
sources.production_scope: Pinned annual or special edition with municipality/canton identifiers, temporal status, LV95 geometry, attribution and digest.
sources.terms_note: Administrative geometry supplies context and partition validation. Locality/postcode perimeters are not congruent with municipalities and retain separate authority.

artifact_partitions.rule: Search receipts, street/sorting directories, NPA6, GeoPost, coordinates and delivery products retain their own product contract and redistribution class.
NPA4/NPA6 locality polygons retain PLZO edition, postcode type, source model, CRS, digest, attribution, topology and CH/LI partition.
Building-address rows retain EGAID, EGID, EDID, status, LV95 point provenance, release and mandatory attribution.
Only reviewed public building and entrance attributes are retained; dwelling, occupant, owner and private-purpose fields stay outside the public pack.
Each tile records model edition and whether the feature contains EGID; no-EGID proximity output remains candidate-only.
swissBOUNDARIES3D geometry retains temporal edition and never inherits postcode assignment or PLZO authority.
Shared source distributions are filtered by authoritative country evidence; LI rows never ship in a CH artifact.
Non-geographic fixtures only; never promotion evidence.
